docs.title: AI chat transcript with streaming and citations
docs.intent: Make AI answers readable while they stream, show where claims come from, and keep the user in control of generation.

docs.title: Calendar scheduling week view
docs.intent: Let users see availability over a week and book or move time reliably, including across time zones.

docs.title: Code review diff view
docs.intent: Let reviewers read changes accurately, navigate files fast, and discuss specific lines.

docs.title: Combobox with autocomplete suggestions
docs.intent: Help users enter a value from a large set quickly and correctly, while still allowing typing.

docs.title: Command palette
docs.intent: Give frequent users a fast way to reach any action or page by typing, without hunting through menus.

docs.title: Dark mode via semantic color mapping
docs.intent: Support light and dark themes from one component codebase with every text and UI pair meeting contrast in both.

docs.title: Dashboard overview with KPI row and table
docs.intent: Let a returning user see what changed since last time and jump to the rows that need action, within one screen.

docs.title: Data table with sort, filter, and row actions
docs.intent: Let users scan, compare, sort, and act on many records without leaving the table.

docs.title: Density modes (comfortable and compact)
docs.intent: Let expert users trade whitespace for information density without degrading touch targets or readability.

docs.title: Destructive action confirmation
docs.intent: Prevent accidental data loss without adding friction to routine, reversible actions.

docs.title: Documentation layout with sidebar and on-page TOC
docs.intent: Let readers find the right page, orient within it, and move to the next step without losing their place.

docs.title: E-commerce variant picker
docs.intent: Help shoppers pick a valid, in-stock combination and understand unavailable ones before adding to cart.

docs.title: Editorial long-form article
docs.intent: Make long text comfortable to read start to finish and give figures and quotes room without breaking the reading rhythm.

docs.title: Empty-state-first workspace
docs.intent: Make the first visit to an empty area useful and show the user how to fill it, instead of a blank table or a decorative illustration.

docs.title: Faceted filter panel
docs.intent: Let users narrow a large set by several attributes and always see and undo what is applied.

docs.title: File upload with drop zone and progress
docs.intent: Let users add files reliably, understand limits before they try, and recover from failed uploads per file.

docs.title: Form with inline validation and error summary
docs.intent: Help users complete a form correctly on the first submit and recover quickly from errors.

docs.title: Map and list split view
docs.intent: Let users compare places both by details and by location without switching views.

docs.title: Multi-step flow with stepper
docs.intent: Break a long task into understandable stages so users know where they are, what is left, and can correct earlier answers.

docs.title: Onboarding checklist home
docs.intent: Get a new user to the first meaningful result with clear next steps instead of an empty dashboard or a product tour.

docs.title: Pricing plan comparison
docs.intent: Help a buyer pick the right plan quickly and verify the details before paying, without hidden conditions.

docs.title: Product detail page
docs.intent: Give a shopper everything needed to decide and buy, with the price, options, and delivery terms visible before they commit.

docs.title: RTL-aware layout with logical properties
docs.intent: Ship one layout that reads correctly in Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu as well as LTR languages, without a separate stylesheet.

docs.title: Scroll-linked reveal with reduced-motion fallback
docs.intent: Add a sense of sequence to a long marketing or story page without hiding content or making anyone wait.

docs.title: Search results page
docs.intent: Help users judge relevance at a glance, narrow results, and recover from an empty result set.

docs.title: Segmented control
docs.intent: Switch between a few views or modes in one click, with the current choice obvious.

docs.title: Skeleton-to-content loading
docs.intent: Make loading feel predictable and avoid layout shift, while still telling the truth when loading is slow or fails.

docs.title: Toast notification queue
docs.intent: Confirm what just happened without interrupting the task, and offer a quick undo where it helps.

docs.title: Token scale recipe for spacing and type
docs.intent: Give a project a small, consistent spacing and type scale that components reference by name instead of literal values.

docs.title: View-transition list reorder
docs.intent: Help users follow items through a sort or reorder instead of losing their place when the list jumps.
